source: NBC 2016 Part 8 (Lighting & Ventilation) / ECBC 2017 Bioclimatic Design Guidelines & Open-Meteo 5-Year Climate Archive
description: Fixed feature specification and order for the EcoShelter Design Recommender ML model. Both training and inference pipelines must strictly adhere to this order.

features.name: latitude
features.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Reflects solar angle and seasonal day-length variation.

features.name: hottest_month_max
features.description: Average daily maximum temperature during the hottest month of the year across a 5-year historical period.

features.name: coldest_month_min
features.description: Average daily minimum temperature during the coldest month of the year across a 5-year historical period.

features.name: coldest_month_mean
features.description: Average daily mean temperature during the coldest month of the year.

features.name: hot_season_humidity
features.description: Average relative humidity during the hottest month or summer season.

features.name: annual_rain
features.description: Average annual total rainfall across the 5-year historical period.

features.name: wind_mean
features.description: Average daily maximum wind speed across all 12 months.

features.name: solar_mean
features.description: Average daily shortwave solar radiation across all 12 months.

features.name: days_above_40
features.description: Average number of days per year where daily maximum temperature reaches or exceeds 40°C.

features.name: days_below_5
features.description: Average number of days per year where daily minimum temperature falls to or below 5°C.
